modules.title: Modules
modules.lead: The sections of the diaspora.ga members’ menu. The network serves the essentials from the start: the feed, members, countries, iCom and the account. Each module is opened or closed here, with a reason, and the decision is recorded in the log. Closing a module deletes no data: reopening it brings everything back.
modules.empty: This network has no module to open.

state.blocked: Closed: its required module is closed

card.adds: What it adds to the members’ menu
card.viaConsole: Decision taken from the platform console.
card.reasonInJournal: The reason can be read in the decision log.
card.neverDecided: No decision: closed since the network opened.
card.decidedButBlocked: Opening decided, with no effect while {{module}} stays closed.
card.blockedByChildren: Closes once the modules that live on it are closed: {{modules}}.
card.addsNothing: Nothing: this module does not change the members’ menu.

prerequisite.team: A moderation team is in place for each open country.
prerequisite.texts: The module’s texts have been reviewed, in French and in English.
prerequisite.rehearsal: The module has been rehearsed in the demo.

code.title: Closed in the code
code.lead: These features of the members’ app are not network modules: they are opened in the diaspora.ga code, never from this app.

descriptions.calls: iCom audio and video calls, one-to-one and in groups.
descriptions.icomPro: iCom’s professional space: shops and introductions.

dialog.openDescription: The module will appear for every member of the network, and the engine will serve its pages.
dialog.closeDescription: The module will disappear for every member of the network, and the engine will refuse its pages. No data is deleted: reopening it brings everything back.
dialog.effectNone: The members’ menu does not change: its entries are already offered by another open module.
dialog.childrenClosed: The modules that live on it are closed: {{modules}}.
dialog.reasonHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} characters. The reason is recorded in the decision log.
dialog.reasonLength: The reason must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters long.
dialog.failed: The decision could not be saved. Try again.

preview.title: Menu preview
preview.lead: The exact diaspora.ga members’ menu for the ticked modules, computed by the same rule as the members’ app. Nothing is saved: opening a module happens in “Modules”.
preview.modulesHint: At first, the modules open today. A module that lives on pages requires pages; pages are unticked once their modules are unticked.

holding.holdsPageRole: Holds a role on a page
holding.moderator: Moderates the network or a country

preview.noChange: No change compared with today’s menu.

lead.ok: The administration application and its engine are responding.
lead.degraded: The engine is not responding normally: some functions may be unavailable.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: This address does not match any administration section.

decision.reasonHint: Required, {{min}} to {{max}} characters. The person concerned will read it: do not include contact details or private data.

lookup.invalid: This public handle is not valid.
lookup.unknown: No active network member has this handle.
lookup.hint: For example firstname.lastname: only an active network member is found.

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.lead: Appeals against a team decision that reached the network, oldest first. Neither the previous decision-maker nor the person appealing reviews them. Every review carries a reason and is written to the decision log.
appeals.emptyBody: An appeal appears here when a person contests a team decision.
appeals.sheetDescription: The contested decision, the reason for the appeal, then your reasoned review.
appeals.upholdHint: The decision and its measures stay in force; the person can still turn to the platform team.
appeals.overturnHint: The measures are lifted and the content is restored if it had been removed.
appeals.doneUpheld: Decision upheld: the appeal has left the queue.
appeals.doneOverturned: Decision overturned: the appeal has left the queue.
appeals.reasonHint: Required. The person concerned will read it: do not include contact details or private data.
appeals.confirmBody: Overturning the decision lifts its measures and restores the content if it had been removed.
appeals.conflict: This appeal changed in the meantime: it has probably been reviewed already. Reread the queue.

party.title: You do not review this appeal
party.handOver: Another network administrator must review it.

team.title: Team and leads
team.lead: The network's leads, then the teams handling the diaspora.ga moderation queue. Every appointment, addition and removal carries a reason and is written to the decision log.
team.countryNote: The engine does not yet attach a team to a country: a team name may say so, it defines no remit.
team.noneYet: No team exists yet: create the first one below.
team.rosterEmpty: This team has no active member yet.
team.rosterMore: Other members exist; only the first ones are shown.
team.outsideNetwork: No longer an active network member.
team.removeBody: This person will no longer read the {{team}} team queue. The removal is reasoned and recorded in the engine's decision log.
team.removed: {{name}} is no longer part of the team.
team.addTitle: Add a member to the {{name}} team
team.added: {{name}} is now part of the team.
team.createLead: A team handles every content type or a single one; creating it requires a reason.
team.name: Team name
team.nameLength: The team name must be between {{nameMin}} and {{nameMax}} characters.
team.failed: The team action did not succeed.

responsibles.title: Network leads
responsibles.lead: The network administration decides here: appeals, teams, leads, rules and modules. The network moderation reads and decides the whole queue on diaspora.ga. Every appointment, change and removal carries a reason and is written to the engine’s decision log; it applies from the person’s next action.
responsibles.inactive: Dormant role: this person's membership is pending or suspended.
responsibles.more: Other leads exist; only the first ones are shown.
responsibles.changeBody: {{name}} will move from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}” from their next action. The change is reasoned and recorded in the engine's decision log.
responsibles.removeBody: {{name}} stays a member of the network, without the “{{role}}” role, from their next action. The removal is reasoned and recorded in the engine's decision log.
responsibles.selfWarning: This is your own role: you will lose its rights with this action.
responsibles.appointLead: Only an active network member, with at least “declared” status, can receive a role; no membership is created. The network always keeps at least one active administrator.
responsibles.handle: Public handle of the person to appoint
responsibles.removed: {{name}} is no longer a network lead.
responsibles.unchanged: {{name}} already has this role: nothing changed.
responsibles.refused: This action did not succeed: a role is only given to an active network member, with at least the “declared” status.
responsibles.failed: The role action did not succeed.

rules.lead: What the network reviews before publication, section by section, and the words that send content to review. Reserved to the network administration; every setting and every word carries a reason and is written to the engine's decision log.

defaults.title: Without a network setting
defaults.preReviewOff: No review before publication: content appears as soon as it is written.
defaults.preReviewOn: Review before publication: every piece of content waits for a moderator.
defaults.links_one: Beyond {{count}} link, content goes to review: it is not refused.
defaults.links_other: Beyond {{count}} links, content goes to review: it is not refused.
defaults.writes_one: Beyond {{count}} write in {{window}}, across all sections, the next one also goes to review.
defaults.writes_other: Beyond {{count}} writes in {{window}}, across all sections, the next one also goes to review.
defaults.terms: Content containing a blocked word goes to review.
defaults.source: These are the defaults of the ANTSIA engine, read as it applies them. They apply to every section without a setting, except the content reviewed by default, listed separately, and the mutual aid, mentoring, arrival kit and jobs sections, published without any rule until a setting is set for them.

held.title: Reviewed by default in DIASPORA.GA
held.lead: Until a setting is set for their section, this content waits for a moderator before it appears:
held.reviews: reviews of a service (section “Review of a service”);
held.reviewReplies: a page's replies to a review (section “Page reply to a review”);
held.note: A setting on one of these sections makes this content follow that setting. On “Event” and “Post”, it also applies to personal events and to every post.

heldNote.associationEvents: Association events stay reviewed by default until a setting is set.
heldNote.eventGallery: Additions to an event gallery stay reviewed by default until a setting is set.

without.defaults: Without a setting: the engine defaults apply.
without.held: Without a setting: every piece of content in this section waits for a moderator before it appears.
without.unchecked: Without a setting: published as soon as it is written and moderated after a report, with no link cap, no pace limit and no blocked words.

surfaces.title: By section
surfaces.lead: The sections of DIASPORA.GA. A setting replaces, for its section, the rule without a setting; it cannot be removed, only changed.

policy.writes_one: At most {{count}} write in {{window}}; beyond that, review.
policy.writes_other: At most {{count}} writes in {{window}}; beyond that, review.

sheet.title: Setting: {{surface}}
sheet.description: Review before publication, link cap and pace for this section. The setting carries a reason and is written to the engine's decision log.
sheet.preReviewHint: Every piece of content in this section waits for a moderator before it appears.
sheet.maxLinksHint: Beyond it, content goes to review; from {{linksMin}} to {{linksMax}}.
sheet.maxWrites: Writes at most within the window
sheet.maxWritesHint: Beyond it, the next one goes to review; from {{writesMin}} to {{writesMax}}.

liftsHeld.associationEvents: Association events are reviewed by default today. This setting applies to every event, association events included: without review before publication, the next one will appear directly if it respects the link cap, the pace and the blocked words.
liftsHeld.reviews: Reviews are reviewed by default today. This setting makes them follow it: without review before publication, the next review will appear directly if it respects the link cap, the pace and the blocked words.
liftsHeld.reviewReplies: A page's replies to a review are reviewed by default today. This setting makes them follow it: without review before publication, the next one will appear directly if it respects the link cap, the pace and the blocked words.
liftsHeld.eventGallery: Additions to an event gallery are reviewed by default today. This setting applies to every post, gallery included: without review before publication, the next addition will appear directly if it respects the link cap, the pace and the blocked words.

sheet.permanent: A setting cannot be removed once set: it can only be changed.
sheet.reasonHint: Why this setting; the reason stays in the decision log ({{min}} to {{max}} characters).

terms.title: Blocked words
terms.lead: Content containing one of these words goes to review: it is not refused. Case and accents do not matter, and the word is also matched inside other words. The network keeps {{termsMax}} at most.
terms.waveNote: The mutual aid, mentoring, arrival kit and jobs sections only read blocked words once a setting is set for them.
terms.emptyBody: The network has not blocked any word yet.
terms.removeBody: Content containing this word will no longer go to review for that reason. The removal carries a reason and is written to the engine's decision log.
terms.termHint: From {{termMin}} to {{termMax}} characters, case and accents removed.
terms.reasonHint: Why this word; the reason stays in the decision log ({{min}} to {{max}} characters).

rules.title: Moderation rules

refusal.links: The link cap goes from {{linksMin}} to {{linksMax}}, as a whole number.
refusal.writes: The pace allows {{writesMin}} to {{writesMax}} writes, as a whole number.
refusal.window: The pace window goes from {{windowMin}} to {{windowMax}} minutes, as a whole number.
refusal.termLength: A blocked word has {{termMin}} to {{termMax}} characters, case and accents removed.
refusal.termsFull: The network already keeps {{termsMax}} blocked words: unblock one before adding another.

baseBelow.memberships_requested: out of fewer than {{threshold}} memberships requested

rate.withheld: rate not published (part below the threshold)
rate.complement: rate not published (gap with the base below the threshold)

duration.hint: From sending to the page’s first proposal or refusal, grouped into hour classes.
duration.sampleBelow: out of fewer than {{threshold}} answered requests

notes.title: What this measurement does not do
notes.noContent: No request, search, message or review text enters these counts.
notes.noPeople: No person identifier is kept in the aggregates and no individual journey is tracked.
notes.threshold: A count below {{threshold}} is shown as “fewer than {{threshold}}”. A rate is only published when its part and its gap with the base reach that threshold.
notes.cohorts: A request, membership or review counts on the day it was created, with its state at the last run. A place counts on the day of its event.
notes.notMeasured: Searches without results and drop-offs are not measured.

durationAid.median: Time to first answer to a question, median
durationAid.p75: Time to first answer to a question, 75th percentile
durationAid.hint: From the question to its oldest answer still published, grouped by hour class.
durationAid.sampleBelow: out of fewer than {{threshold}} answered questions

closed.title: The “Metrics” module is closed
closed.body: The pilot metrics can only be read once the “Metrics” module is opened in the “Modules” section. While it is closed, the engine serves no figure, and none is shown in its place.

journal.emptyFilteredBody: The journal was read to the end: it holds no decision of this type.
journal.systemActor: The engine, with no human author
